findings.evidence: `Circle.lean:106` defines only the deprecated `windingNumber_modelSector_interval` alias, while `Circle.lean:122` names the former arc result `indexIntegral_arc`; `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/ContourIntegration/Suggested.lean:167` confirms the old public `windingNumber_modelSector` signature.
findings.fix: Keep the arc theorem available as deprecated `windingNumber_modelSector` and give the new closed-sector theorem a distinct name (for example `windingNumber_closedModelSector`).
findings.issue: `windingNumber_modelSector` replaces the prior public arc theorem with a closed-curve theorem of a different signature; the retained alias covers only `windingNumber_modelSector_interval`, so downstream uses of the old name break.

summary: The PR reuses an existing public theorem name for an incompatible statement, breaking downstream source compatibility.
